note: STAND-IN ITEMS. These 18 items are original placeholder wording written for this build. They are NOT the OCI-R and are not a validated scale. The design doc calls for the OCI-R (Foa et al., 2002, Psychological Assessment 14(4), 485-496). Its reuse terms for a public app are unconfirmed, so its wording is not reproduced here. To install a licensed scale: replace 'instruction', 'labels' and 'items' with the official text, keep 18 items scored 0-4, and set 'validated' to true (this hides the in-app draft notice).
instruction: Over the past week, how much did each of these bother you?
items: Going back to make sure I had done something.
Reading the same lines more than once to be sure I took them in.
Asking someone to tell me things were all right.
Paying close attention to sensations in my body.
Finding it hard to move on without feeling certain.
Looking over my work again before I could let it go.
Rereading messages before or after sending them.
Searching online to settle a worry.
Thoughts I did not want kept coming back.
Replaying events in my head to make sure nothing went wrong.
Returning to doors, switches or appliances after leaving them.
Needing to understand something completely before continuing.
Asking the same question again in a different way.
Worrying about what a sensation might mean.
Feeling that something was not quite finished or not quite right.
Taking longer over tasks because of checking.
Trying hard to push a thought out of my mind.
Putting things off until I could feel sure.
